title: My Faceless Classmate, Wakao
titleRomaji: Tonari no Wakao-san wa Miesou de Mienai
titleNative: 隣の若尾さんは見えそうで見えない
synonyms: My Seatmate Wakao-san's Face Is Almost Visible but It's Not
synopsis: Mizuno, your average high-school guy, finds himself sitting next to the mysterious Wakao after a seat change. While everyone else in class sees her as a perfectly beautiful, ordinary girl... To Mizuno alone, she appears as a Noppera-bo, the faceless yokai of Japanese folklore! Yet... every so often, he’s actually able to catch rare, fleeting glimpses of her features. In this romantic, often comedic coming-of-age tale, we follow this endearing couple as they navigate through the tribulations of high-school and first love! (Source: Manga UP!)

title: Tetsuwan Birdy Evolution
synopsis: After two years of being dormant inside Tsutomu Senkawa, an accidental encounter with their old nemesis violently wakes Birdy up. With Birdy kicking evil's ass once again, the dark secrets of the experiments conducted by the "Agni" corporation are slowly revealed. They seem to be dabbling with human body enhancement, creating what they call "beast men," to combat the alien invasions related to Birdy. (Source: MangaHelpers)

title: Mikoto-chan wa Kirawaretakunai!
titleNative: みことちゃんは嫌われたくない!
synopsis: My beautiful, big-breasted childhood friend, Mikoto, is completely in love with me. It sounds like a dream scenario that anyone would envy — but there’s just one big problem... She’s turned into a clingy, mentally unstable mess with love that's way too heavy!! This is a dark everyday comedy about being at the mercy of Mikoto’s unstable behavior and unintentional sexiness. Note: Mikoto-chan wa Kirawaretakunai! began as a web manga shared on the author's Twitter starting February 15, 2023, and has been published in print by Kadokawa since January 18, 2024.

It's a Little Late, but I've Fallen in Love with My Childhood Friend
synopsis: I've known Ta-kun ever since we were 10 years old. Even though we are now in high school, we still spend our days in his room, talking about nothing in particular. We are close, but our relationship is not quite as sweet as lovers… Why won't you notice me? I'm trying so hard to get closer to you! I am Hikari Shirasaka, 16 years old… It might be a little late for me to tell you this, but I think I've fallen in love with you, my childhood friend. (Source: ComicWalker, translated) Note: Originally self-published, it was picked up for commercial serialization starting 2025-02-17.

synonyms: Two Girls in Love with High Grade Model Kits
Two People in Love with HG
synopsis: When she was 14, Sayaka Kanzaki had her first encounter with Gundam, and her fascination for MS was awakened as if by fate. But her family and friends did not understand the hobby, so she had to hide her interest from the world. Until one day, when she met a high school girl, Sora Takamiya, who loved Gundam models, too...! When two people who love Gundam meet, it's the beginning of something new–––. A story about how it feels “to like” something; a “Gunpla” slice-of-life comedy featuring an almost-thirty OL and a JK!! (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Notes - Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Manga Category. - Includes 15 extra chapters.
